definition.en: A name made popular in the 19th century for the many land and sea routes that linked Asia, Europe and Africa. Far more than silk travelled on them.
definition.zh: 19 世纪以后流行起来的名字，指连接亚洲、欧洲和非洲的许多条陆路和海路。路上运的远不止丝绸。

definition.en: The sea trade routes that linked East Asia, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Arabia and East Africa. Ships carried much more than silk, and the name was given in modern times.
definition.zh: 把东亚、东南亚、南亚、阿拉伯和东非连在一起的海上贸易路线。船上运的远不止丝绸；这个名字是近代才起的。

definition.en: A large wind system that changes direction with the seasons. Sailing ships timed their voyages out and back by it.
definition.zh: 随季节改变方向的大范围的风。帆船按季风安排出航和返航的时间。

definition.en: A place in a desert with enough water for people to farm and live.
definition.zh: 沙漠中有足够的水、人可以耕种和居住的地方。

definition.en: A group of traders travelling together with camels, horses or donkeys to carry goods over long distances.
definition.zh: 结伴用骆驼、马或驴长途驮运货物的一群商人。

definition.en: The name Chinese histories from the Han onwards used for the lands west of the Yumen and Yang passes. Many separate states lay there, each with its own ruler.
definition.zh: 汉代以后中国史书对玉门关、阳关以西地区的称呼。那里有许多各自独立、各有君主的国家。

definition.en: The highest Han official in the Western Regions, first appointed in 60 BCE.
definition.zh: 汉朝在西域设置的最高长官，公元前 60 年首次设置。

definition.en: A people of Central Asia from the region around Samarkand. Sogdian merchants travelled and lived as far east as China.
definition.zh: 中亚的一个民族，来自撒马尔罕一带。粟特商人一直走到中国，也在那里居住。

definition.en: A Christian church whose missionaries reached China in the 7th century. The Tang called it Jingjiao.
definition.zh: 一个基督教会，7 世纪它的传教士到达中国。唐代称之为“景教”。

definition.en: A religion founded by Mani in Sasanian Iran in the 3rd century. It spread east; the Uyghur rulers adopted it in the 8th century.
definition.zh: 3 世纪摩尼在萨珊伊朗创立的宗教，后来向东传播，8 世纪回鹘统治者皈依了它。

definition.en: A state ruled by a caliph, a successor of the Prophet Muhammad as leader of the Muslim community.
definition.zh: 由哈里发统治的国家。哈里发是先知穆罕默德的继承者、穆斯林社群的领袖。

definition.en: A state ruled by a khan. In the 13th and 14th centuries Mongol rulers held several khanates, among them the Golden Horde, the Chagatai khanate and the Ilkhanate.
definition.zh: 由可汗统治的国家。13、14 世纪，蒙古统治者分据几个汗国，其中有金帐汗国、察合台汗国和伊利汗国。

definition.en: A disease caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis. The great pandemic of the 1340s was later called the Black Death.
definition.zh: 由鼠疫杆菌引起的疾病。14 世纪 40 年代的大流行，后来被称为“黑死病”。
